description: A second provider entry that holds only the address, because the auto-models plugin fills in the models map and the key comes from the /connect step.

steps.description: This is a second provider entry, added to the `provider` map you wrote earlier. It holds only the address: no key and no `models` map, because the plugin fills the models in. `myendpoint` is a placeholder ID you type again in the next step.
The provider ID is `myendpoint`, `npm` is `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`, and `name` is `My Endpoint`.
`options.baseURL` is `https://YOUR-ENDPOINT/api/v1`, a placeholder for your URL.

steps.question: The page says `/connect` asks only for the ID and the key, never what, which is why step 2 comes first?
